name: @helpdesk/endpoint-gateway
description: Endpoint gateway: MCP server on @helpdesk/gateway-core. Two reads and one approval-gated write against a small local stub endpoint service (SPRINT3.md, 3.4) — every organisation runs different endpoint tooling, so this stands in for one rather than pretending to integrate with a specific product. Also holds reset_password: registered as a tool so the refusal is nameable and auditable, but never executed — the policy engine denies it unconditionally, and this gateway holds no password-reset permission in Entra at all (SPRINT3.md, 3.4: password reset moved to the never-automated class before this phase began).

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && vitest run
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
